subject: Problems to generate several jobs at the same time with add_generator

messages.author: c02c4bf2101897a8
messages.subject: Problems to generate several jobs at the same time with add_generator
parts:
Hello,

I have a similar problem as in this post:
https://groups.google.com/d/msg/simmer-devel/LAVTzuEAcAE/hdK6SkpSAgAJ

I want to generate 10 arrivals at the same time and start at time 0
How can I do this with add_generator?

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Problems to generate several jobs at the same time with add_generator
parts:
On Tue, 4 Feb 2020 at 09:34, Krocki26412 <a.i.a-c...@t-online.de> wrote:
>
> Hello,
>
> I have a similar problem as in this post:
> https://groups.google.com/d/msg/simmer-devel/LAVTzuEAcAE/hdK6SkpSAgAJ
>
> I want to generate 10 arrivals at the same time and start at time 0
> How can I do this with add_generator?

As I replied in that post, use "rep" to fill with zeroes. In your case,

add_generator("dummy", some_trajectory, function() rep(0, 10))

A generator generates interarrival times. Returning a zero means that
a new arrival will be created at the same time as the previous one.

Iñaki
